content2.content: State management is about how you share data across your app and update the UI when that data changes.

content4.content: State that is contained within a single widget (e.g., current tab, animation value). Use `setState`.

content6.content: State that is shared across many parts of the app (e.g., user authentication, shopping cart). Use `Provider`, `Riverpod`, or `BLoC`.

content8.content: Choose the simplest solution that fits your needs. Don't use Redux for a counter app.
